info.title: 315 PLOTS API
info.description:
Backend for the 315 PLOTS mobile app. Roles: USER (customer; partner once approved) and ADMIN.

Auth: call POST /auth/otp/request then /auth/otp/verify, click Authorize and paste the accessToken.

Money is integer paise (amountPaise 2100000 = Rs 21,000). Lists take page/size (max 50). Errors: { code, message, requestId }. Full guide: docs/API_REFERENCE.pdf.
